name: Argil
tagline: Generate avatar videos from a script — clone yourself or pick from 100+ avatars.
description: Argil is an AI video platform that turns scripts and articles into talking-avatar videos. You can clone your own likeness from a single photo and a short voice recording, or use one of 100+ ready-made avatars, then let Argil auto-add captions, B-roll, backgrounds, and transitions. It targets creators and marketers producing short-form and faceless video at scale, with output rendered in roughly a couple of minutes.
insight: Backed by Y Combinator; it clones your likeness from a single photo and about a minute of voice to drive its avatar videos.
edge: Clone yourself from one photo and a minute of audio, then auto-generate avatar videos with captions, B-roll, and transitions in about two minutes.
pros: Self-clone from one photo + short audio
cons: Credit limits scale with plan price
Unlimited styles need the Pro tier
